1: ## 1. Tool Setup

8: ## 2. Spec File Scanner

14: - [x] 2.5 Ignore FR-* IDs in non-requirement contexts (examples, paragraphs)

16: ## 3. Code Annotation Scanner
17: 
18: - [x] 3.1 Implement recursive directory scan for `src/**/*.ts` and `tests/**/*.ts`
19: - [x] 3.2 Parse JSDoc comment blocks using regex to extract `@implements {FR-XXX-NNN}` and `@satisfies {FR-XXX-NNN}`
20: - [x] 3.3 Build annotation registry: `Map<frId, Array<{ file, line, tag, context }>>`
21: - [x] 3.4 Handle multiple annotations per JSDoc block
22: - [x] 3.5 Ignore FR-* IDs in non-JSDoc comments and string literals
23: - [x] 3.6 Report malformed annotations (missing braces, invalid format)

25: ## 4. Coverage Validation Engine
26: 
27: - [x] 4.1 Compare requirement registry against annotation registry
28: - [x] 4.2 Identify uncovered requirements (in specs, not in code)
29: - [x] 4.3 Identify orphaned annotations (in code, not in specs)
30: - [x] 4.4 Calculate coverage percentage: `covered / total * 100`
31: - [x] 4.5 Generate structured report object with all findings

33: ## 5. Output Formatters
34: 
35: - [x] 5.1 Implement human-readable text formatter with colored output
36: - [x] 5.2 Implement JSON formatter (`--format json`) for CI consumption
37: - [x] 5.3 Print summary: total requirements, covered, uncovered, orphaned, coverage %
38: - [x] 5.4 Print detailed list of uncovered requirements with spec file references
39: - [x] 5.5 Print detailed list of orphaned annotations with file/line references

41: ## 6. CLI and Exit Behavior
42: 
43: - [x] 6.1 Exit with code 0 when coverage is 100% with no orphaned annotations
44: - [x] 6.2 Exit with code 1 when any requirement is uncovered
45: - [x] 6.3 Exit with code 1 when any orphaned annotation exists
46: - [x] 6.4 Support `--help` flag showing usage
47: - [x] 6.5 Support `--verbose` flag for detailed per-file scanning output

49: ## 7. CI Integration

52: - [x] 7.2 Configure step to run `npm run validate:traceability`
53: - [x] 7.3 Ensure CI fails on uncovered requirements
54: - [x] 7.4 Add CI step to upload JSON report as artifact

68: ## 9. Documentation
